### What is The mean theorem

<!--FIELD-->

The mean theorem states that if $f$ is a **continuous** function on the closed interval $[a, b]$ and **differentiable** on the open interval $(a, b)$, then there exists a point $c$ in $(a, b)$ such that the **tangent** at $c$ is parallel to the **secant line** through the endpoints ${\displaystyle {\big (}a,f(a){\big )}}$ and ${\displaystyle {\big (}b,f(b){\big )}}$, that is:
$${\displaystyle f'(c)={\frac {f(b)-f(a)}{b-a}}.}$$
